title: Reset your password
text: Users can reset a forgotten password from the account recovery page.

title: Recover account access
text: If you cannot sign in because you forgot your login credentials, follow the account recovery process.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: Troubleshoot verification codes and regain access when two-factor authentication fails.

title: Account security
text: Protect your account by changing your password and reviewing recent sign-in activity.

title: Change account email
text: Update the email address associated with your profile from account settings.

title: Cancel an order
text: Orders can be cancelled within 30 minutes of purchase if they have not been processed.

title: Track a shipment
text: View delivery progress and estimated arrival dates on the order tracking page.

title: Refund policy
text: Eligible returned purchases are refunded after the returned item has been inspected.

title: Cloud storage plans
text: Premium members receive additional cloud storage for their uploaded files.

title: Billing problems
text: Check payment history and resolve failed charges from your billing settings.

title: Cooking pasta
text: Boil salted water, add pasta, and cook until it reaches the desired texture.

title: Apply for developer jobs
text: Find software engineering openings and submit your resume to recruiting teams.
